description: I'm a passionate software developer interested in Java, Python, web development, AI, and innovative problem-solving. I'm excited to build a Space Mission Design Game that makes space exploration interactive and educational. I'm looking for enthusiastic teammates skilled in frontend/backend development, UI/UX design, AI/ML, data analytics, and space science. Let's collaborate, innovate, and build something amazing!
summary:
QORVIA — Explore beyond. Discover within. 

QORVIA is an AI-powered, interactive lunar astronaut mission trainer designed for young explorers aged 7–12. Experience the challenges of surviving on the Moon through an immersive, decision-driven simulation where every choice matters.

Manage life support, oxygen, power, radiation safety, and lunar outpost operations while learning real space science through NASA data, AI-powered guidance, and interactive mission storytelling.

Built with:Java 21, Spring Boot, Next.js, React, TypeScript, PostgreSQL, Google Gemini AI, and NASA Open APIs.

Created for the NASA Space Apps Challenge 2026 by Team AgentSpace.

*Explore beyond. Discover within.
